title: Language as a Tonal Medium
idiom: pen-and-ink stipple, a face made of marks of different weight
hero_prompt: Pen-and-ink stipple drawing on cream paper, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a woman's face in profile drawn entirely from tiny hand-inked marks, dots, short dashes, small crosses and little open circles, dense and heavy in the shadows and sparse and light in the highlights, so the weight of the marks themselves makes the tones of the face; the marks thin out into empty paper at the edges.
icon_prompt: Ink emblem, a flat single-colour black on cream, no shading or gradients: a bold circle filled with dots that are large and crowded on the left and small and sparse on the right, a gradient made only of marks. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
